preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of segments in each test case is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The attractiveness of each shop is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output is a single integer for each test case
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output should be the minimal possible velocity at the beginning that satisfies all conditions.
